activity_summary: From the corner of Great St Helen's lane you saw Crosby Place's shut gate and one lit window in the oriel. You did not go to the gate. You did not look for a word from the house. You walked on into the close.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once from the corner and went on into the close.

entities.name: Crosby Place
entities.context: Mentioned in Torchlight at Crosby Place gate

facets.activity: Saw Crosby Place from the corner of the lane
